scope: Single-file background import and local scene resource relocation
assertions: GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, DXF, CSV parse in module workers; DXF layer discovery and CSV preview also run in workers
One file per operation; multiple SHP layers within one ZIP remain supported
Cancellation, dialog disposal and project replacement terminate workers and reject stale results
Chinese fields, leading zeros, source IDs, CRS normalization and import warnings survive background parsing
30000 generated GeoJSON features parse with main-thread timer activity; not a maximum-size benchmark
Confirmation creates one undoable import; preview does not mutate the project
File or parent-directory relocation previews affected assets and preserves relative paths below the old directory
Sibling directories and network assets remain unchanged; inherited locks and stale references reject atomic updates
Cancel, undo and redo preserve exact project snapshots and scene nodes
Save As relative references resolve to the same relocated resources after serialization and reopening
Actual browser project download uses the live camera; reopening matches the complete saved scene
boundaries: Browser tests validate persisted references and product behavior; native directory picker and local GLTF/Tileset dependency rendering require Windows acceptance
Native filesystem read requests are checked for cancellation after completion; active parsing workers are terminated immediately
Not streaming or unbounded-memory import; native IPC reads, result cloning and rendering retain memory costs
Relocation updates references, not filesystem contents; load errors remain visible and retryable
Native Windows 125 percent scaling and physical GPU acceptance remain open
